title: Notifications on this device
installIntro: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work when you open moto from the Home Screen.
installStepsLabel: Add moto to the Home Screen
installStep2: Scroll down in the menu and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
installStep3: Tap “Add”. Then open moto using the new icon.
installOutro: Open Settings again in the installed app. You can turn on notifications there with one tap.
unsupportedBody: Open moto in Safari, Chrome, Edge, or Firefox and try again there.
blockedBody: Open your device or browser settings, find moto, and allow notifications. Then return here.
offBody: moto tells you about important updates, even when the app is closed.
permissionHint: After you tap the button, your device asks for permission once. Choose “Allow”.
onBody: This device shows new notifications from moto.
enabledMessage: Notifications are on for this device.
disabledMessage: Notifications are off for this device.
enableError: Notifications could not be turned on. Please try again.
installOffer: You can install moto on this device. moto then opens like an app, without the browser bar.
installNotNeeded: On this device that is not needed. Notifications also arrive in the browser.
installIntroAndroid: This puts moto on your home screen like an app.
installStepAndroid1: Tap the three dots at the top right of the browser.
installStepAndroid2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to home screen”.
installStepAndroid3: Confirm with “Install”. Then open moto from the new icon.
installOutroAndroid: Open the settings again inside the app. There you can turn notifications on with one tap.
